subject: Adding all JSON command definition (#42)
reason: The change adds only documentation artifacts: a README wording edit and 21 new src/commands/*.json command-definition metadata files. Nothing in the build (src/CMakeLists.txt compiles a fixed list of .cc files) or in the module source references src/commands/, and the actual command registration, arity, key specs and ACL categories in json.cc's ValkeyModule_OnLoad are unchanged. The compiled module at the change is behaviorally identical to the parent, so there is no reachable behavior difference to test.
